items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: He began to show me things and then from him, I used to go to his house all the time and he taught me. I say he was responsible for as much as I know today about the playing

ctx.x: All of them played the piano. So I was around their house and then Steve Lewis, he came along and he was a very good pianist. And then I began to... He began to show me things and then from him, I used to go to his house all the time and he taught me. I say he was responsible for as much as I know today about the playing because he was a very good pianist and he used to like me and everything he knew he would show me.
He really showed you then. You didn't just listen to him, he showed you how to...
